_about: Added under the daily Discord digest (report/discord-digest.js) until 'until' (New York date). Leo 2026-10-19: the bot asks the design team for this week's trial feedback. Empty text or a past date = nothing added.
text:
📝 **Trial feedback this week — please answer in this channel by Fri, Oct 23** (one line each is fine)
1. **Design Board**: did you put any review comments on it? If not, what stopped you?
2. **🔍 Check DXF** (Drawings → 🔍 Check DXF): run it on one sheet set you're working on. Which findings were real mistakes, which were false alarms, and what did it miss?
3. **One thing** that would make you use the board every day instead of only Discord.
